issue.title: Scope wait resolution to live waiters so wait_checks stops timing out
issue.description: A wait_checks tick with live named-agent waiters loads only the artifact rows those waiters can depend on instead of the whole artifact history. Ticks stay far below the 2-minute job timeout under host load, release latency moves toward sase-1hn's p50 <= 5 s / p95 <= 15 s target, and parked runners' 60 s fallback stops rebuilding the full project history. Release decisions stay exactly what the full view would decide.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/wait_checks_scoped_view.md requests this work
